Archival Dispatch: 15 Historical Broadcasts Dated Across Armed Forces Command Performance and Strange As It Seems

Author: radio index
Reading: 3 min
Tags: Command Performance, AFRS, Bing Crosby, Ethel Merman, Strange As It Seems, John Hix, Original Filenames

Batch 15 Forensic Discoveries

Batch 15 resolves 15 historic network and syndicated broadcasts: 5 flagship wartime and postwar episodes of Armed Forces Radio Service's Command Performance (starring Bing Crosby, Ethel Merman, Jackie Gleason, Benny Goodman, and Lionel Barrymore) and 10 weekly episodes from John Hix's famous 1939 syndicated docudrama series Strange As It Seems (sponsored by Ex-Lax).

1. Command Performance — AFRS Master Disc Broadcasts Dated

Produced by the War Department and Armed Forces Radio Service for American troops worldwide:

Original Circulating Filename Canonical Title Verified Airdate All-Star Cast & Repertoire
Command_Performance_145_Merman_Lewis.mp3 "Command Performance 145: Ethel Merman, Joe E. Lewis, Connie Boswell" 1944-11-01 Broadway legend Ethel Merman and comedian Joe E. Lewis headline for overseas GIs.
Command_Performance_152_Goodman_Romay.mp3 "Command Performance 152: Benny Goodman, Lina Romay, Hoagy Carmichael" 1944-12-16 King of Swing Benny Goodman sextet with singer Lina Romay and Hoagy Carmichael.
Command_Performance_198_Crosby_Maxwell.mp3 "Command Performance 198: Bing Crosby, Marilyn Maxwell, Lionel Barrymore" 1945-10-28 Postwar victory broadcast with Bing Crosby, Marilyn Maxwell, and Lionel Barrymore.
Command_Performance_392_Whiting_Niles.mp3 "Command Performance 392: Margaret Whiting, Wendell Niles, Jack Smith, Steve Allen" 1949-07-24 AFRS summer variety showcase featuring young Steve Allen and Margaret Whiting.
Command_Performance_479_Gray_Gleason.mp3 "Command Performance 479: Coleen Gray, Jackie Gleason, Fred Allen" 1950-02-12 Comedy sketch showcase featuring Jackie Gleason and radio giant Fred Allen.
